steps.p: The world's news from hundreds of newsrooms, checked and explained. This one-minute tour shows you how to read it.
Everything is in six places: Sections, World (countries and maritime), Risk (trackers, signals, warnings), the Daily briefing and the Mind Graph.
Type a country, a company or a topic - ATHENA finds the events about it.
The rolling bar shows the newest important events. Tap one to open it.
Importance (0-10) is how widely it is covered, Risk (0-10) how serious the harm described is, and Confidence (%) how many independent, reliable sources back it.
Every event lists the newsrooms that reported it, each linking to its original article. ATHENA writes no news of its own.
Night mode, colours and text size - your choice is remembered on this device.
The Help button explains what each page shows. You can take this tour again from there.
Follow ATHENA for breaking events and the daily briefing.
